title: PERF Vectorize adjacency matrix construction in plot_wikipedia_principal_eigenvector.py
body:
#### Reference Issues/PRs

Related to #34958 (reduces the same example's runtime further, via a different, complementary change).

#### What does this implement/fix? Explain your changes.

Avoid a Python loop `for i, j in links: X[i, j] = 1.0` by using directly the csr_array constructor.

Beyond the runtime win, this also showcases better practice for this kind of example: avoid Python loops over data, prefer vectorized numpy/scipy operations.

#### AI usage

Yes, but tightly reviewed.

#### Benchmarks

Measured locally on the full DBpedia 3.5.1 dump (data already downloaded/cached), comparing this branch to `main` (`limit=5_000_000`, before #34958's unrelated reduction to `limit=3_000_000`), same machine, back-to-back runs:

```
main (lil_array loop):    67.5s wall clock
this branch (coo_array):  51.0s wall clock
```
